notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.2_5.b7c2
notes.notes:
Dear Managers, 



A new update is now available: Version 1.0.2_5.b7c2 


Fixes


- Fixed table placement: if you see a red table, simply replace it 

- Added the ability to box storages, provided they are empty 

- Adjusted certain interaction distances 

- Fixed the issue of ghost dishes on trays and carts 



If you ever have employees getting stuck, it is most likely due to a table. While this issue should no longer occur, please feel free to report it if you still encounter it. 



Stay tuned, more is coming soon: Steam Achievements, flowers and plants, new dishes, and much more 🥐

notes.title: Update 1.0.2_4.b7c2
notes.notes:
Dear Manager,



Here is a new update that fixes several bugs along with a few adjustments.

 
Additions
Added toggle sprint, with a key that can be customized in the settings.  

By pressing this key, sprint will be forced as the default movement mode.  

The default key is Left Ctrl. 


Changes
Double doors have been reworked to prevent employees from getting stuck. They now open automatically when passing in front, and collisions have been removed.

Running speed has been slightly increased


Fixes
Fixed various delivery issues

Fixed the table reservation tutorial in Chinese, Japanese, and Korean

Bar doors, which were too problematic, have been removed

Fixed the wooden floor texture when placed upstairs

You need to place a new floor to correct the issue, which can be ordered from the "IPEA" app.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2_3.b7c2: Stuck Delivery Workers
notes.notes:
Dear players 🥐



You may have encountered an issue where delivery workers remained stuck inside the truck, holding boxes without placing them into storage.



This problem has been fixed in this patch.



We will keep addressing issues and adjusting the game balance.

Stay tuned, and don’t hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2_2.b7c2: Table Numbers & Bugs
notes.notes:
Dear Managers,



Here are the changes included in this version. They mainly come from your feedback, as well as some bugs we detected.


Rework of table numbers
When ordering a dish with the tablet, it is no longer necessary to select a table. A dish ordered without an associated table will not have a ticket with a table number.

For dishes ordered and associated with a table, it is now possible to deliver them to another table with a different number. This is no longer blocked.

Employees will now only pick up dishes from the counter if they are associated with a table.


Changes
- Serving dishes by employees is now counted towards mission objectives to unlock new dishes.

- Boxes containing a floor can now be resold to Joe.


Fixes
- Fixed the truck not leaving its delivery point.

- Fixed an issue that caused tables to be marked as invalid (red) without any valid reason.


[hr][/hr]


Reminder

If, when starting your game, you see some of your tables marked in red, it means their placement is invalid. Simply move them to fix it.



What's next?

We are moving into a new phase of adjustments and bug fixes, including:

- a parameter to adjust how quickly satisfaction increases 

- a key to toggle sprint

- a better sales report



At the same time, we are progressing on the roadmap, including:

- achievements coming very soon

- a new language being added in the game

- new decoration props (we will release a devlog dedicated to this topic)

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2.b7c2 – Musics
notes.notes:
Dear Managers,



This hotfix focuses on adding and removing certain music tracks.
Although they were royalty-free for commercial use, some of them could still trigger alerts for content creators.



To avoid this, we removed the problematic tracks and added a new, more modern one.



Thank you for your support and feedback. The next update will focus on several fixes reported in the past few days, including a long-awaited change:


The rework of table numbers.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1.b7c2 – Employee Blocking Fix
notes.notes:
Dear Managers,



The placement of tables previously allowed certain invalid positions, which could block employees.

This hotfix adds additional checks to prevent such invalid placements.


⚠️ Attention


Your already placed tables may now be flagged as invalid and appear in red.
If this happens, simply move the table or place it in a box to set it aside.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/70a48de58d78dcaaf5ab534ce8e2c1e4ad42d52f.png"]

We’ve taken into account your recent bug reports, whether shared through the hub, Discord/QQ, or your Steam reviews. Please know that we are moving forward tirelessly and carefully considering each of your feedback to refine the game experience. A new update is coming soon with many adjustments, and we’ll be bringing you the content from the roadmap very shortly.

Thank you all for your interest in the game. We continue working to provide you with a stable experience and new features. Stay tuned, more is coming soon! 🥐

notes.title: Valentine's Day Update (0.0.6.0) !
notes.notes:
Dear Managers,

We have just released a new update for Valentine's Day!

Here are all the changes:

Added

Added a "Smart Margins" button to the Menu app
Added automatic saving when changing days
Added a dish filter in the eRundis app
Added keys for fun interactions in the HUD


Fixed

Fixed the Ray-Tracing option being enabled on unsupported graphics cards
Fixed a bug that prevented the brasserie doors from closing in certain cases
Fixed a bug that allowed changing days without closing the brasserie doors in certain cases
Fixed the economic delivery option not being available even after the first order
Fixed the end-of-day time display, it will now correctly show 00:00 instead of 00:01


Changed

Reworked table placement, they now take up much less space
Reduced restricted placement areas
Balanced the economy (lowered the cost of certain ingredients and tables, increased possible margins)
The "Smart Order" button in the eRundis app no longer takes disabled dishes into account
When a computer app is closed, filters are reset
The bottom bar in the HUD will remain visible even when using the computer
Reduced the delay to close the brasserie doors when the last group leaves
Lowered the ingredient threshold before appearing as "Low Stock"
Changed the font for better readability of pinned missions
Increased starting money from €3,000 to €5,000
Changed the default key for the tray, now set to E
Increased glass opacity for better visibility
Added the ability to exit the computer using the ESC key
